## Summary Optimize Kimi-K3 mono speculative verification for conc4 serving on MI355X TP8, with selected batches through **32 verification tokens per step (M32)**. This covers four requests with up to eight verification tokens each. Dispatch follows the model step's row count; batches above M32 use the existing vLLM operators. - **K1:** bounded LDS staging, tiled state updates and shape-specific worker assignments. - **K1/K2 fusion:** one persistent launch with worker reuse for eligible batches through M16. - **K2:** compact routing and cached expert intermediates through M32, with projection-panel pipelining at M28/M30/M32. - **Graph replay:** immutable pinned argument tables remain alive across capture and replay. This extends #60683 at `9c6c96d8ef` with K1/K2 worker reuse and panel-based K2 scheduling for speculative verification. The scope differs from #61435's row-tiling and MLA prologue/epilogue fusion; MLA attention and DCP output merging complete before this PR's K2 consumes their output. ## Performance — AgenticX conc4 **Kimi-K3 · 8× MI355X · TP8/DCP1 · DSpark k5 · 3600 seconds.** FP8 GPU KV cache, offload disabled, prefix caching enabled, FULL_AND_PIECEWISE graphs; synthetic acceptance length 3.62, seed 42. Concurrency 4 refers to AgenticX session trees. | Metric | Base (no mono) | #60683 | #61694 | vs base | vs #60683 | |---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:| | Output tok/s | 159.84 | 181.91 | 190.84 | +19.4% | +4.9% | | Total tok/s | 22453.69 | 24149.27 | 25436.55 | +13.3% | +5.3% | | Mean / median TTFT ms | 1061.39 / 521.11 | 790.88 / 525.92 | 828.82 / 523.70 | −21.9% | +4.8% | | Mean / median TPOT ms | 5.47 / 6.36 | 4.82 / 4.47 | 4.80 / 4.39 | −12.2% | −0.4% | | Mean ITL ms | 5.47 | 4.82 | 4.80 | −12.2% | −0.4% | | p90 interactivity tok/s | 118.98 | 123.45 | 146.53 | +23.2% | +18.7% | Percentage changes compare #61694 with each reference and use the mean for paired latency rows. Interactivity follows AgenticX's definition: `1 / p90 ITL` with ITL in seconds; higher is better. All three benchmark results passed validation; successful/failed profiling requests were 475/2, 507/3 and 538/2, respectively. *Measurement scope: one run per build. The #60683 reference is `9c6c96d8ef`; the #61694 candidate was measured before the M32 cap, on a different MI355X TP8 system from Base/#60683, with different KV-cache capacity. These comparisons do not isolate the kernel effect; throughput of the current M32 revision remains pending.* ## Kernel design K1 covers attention residual mixing and normalization, input projection, convolution, KDA state updates and gated RMSNorm. K2 covers output projection, TP reduction, MLP residual mixing, routed/shared experts and the final reductions. | Rows in the step | Selected implementation | |---|---| | 1–16 | K2; eligible KDA verification lengths 2, 4, 6 or 8 use combined K1/K2 outside FULL graphs | | 18, 20, 24 | K2 with compact routing metadata, sparse expert-pick lists and expert intermediates cached in LDS | | 28, 30, 32 | The same K2 schedule, with projection consumers advancing on ready input panels | | Other widths | Existing projection and MoE operators; eligible K1/post-projection KDA paths are also bounded by M32 | ### Small batches: reuse K1 workers in K2 The #60683 snapshot uses separate K1 and K2 launches for batches through eight rows. This PR combines eligible batches through sixteen rows: ```mermaid flowchart LR subgraph F["K1 + K2: one persistent launch"] A["AttnRes + input RMSNorm"] --> B["Input projection + f_b
bounded LDS slices"] B --> C["Convolution + gates
tiled KDA state update"] C --> D["Gated RMSNorm
publish ready values"] W["Completed K1 workers
prefetch K2 weights"] --> E["K2 output projection"] D -->|"matching epoch ready"| E E --> G["TP sum + MLP AttnRes
routed and shared experts"] G --> H["Latent TP sum + RMSNorm
up projection + shared merge
final TP sum"] end ``` Each CTA reuses its workers and private LDS as its work completes. Epoch-tagged handoffs prevent K2 from reading unfinished K1 output; TP consumers also wait for the required peer data. FULL graph execution uses separate launches. ### M18–M32: compact K2 routing and panel handoffs Wide K2 stores compact routing metadata and sparse expert-pick lists, keeping expert intermediates in LDS. At M28/M30/M32, the output-projection reduction and MLP AttnRes publish input panels for the router, latent projection and shared-expert projection. M30/M32 KDA uses the existing input projection followed by eligible fused post-projection work. Deep residual-block schedules use streamed AttnRes staging to bound LDS usage. ```mermaid flowchart LR A["Output projection"] --> B["TP sum + MLP AttnRes"] B -->|"ready input panel"| R["Router + top-16 selection"] B -->|"ready input panel"| L["Latent down projection
+ quantization"] B -->|"ready input panel"| S["Shared gate/up projection
+ SiTU"] R --> X["Selected experts
gate/up + SiTU + down"] L --> X X --> N["Latent TP sum + RMSNorm"] S --> SD["Shared down projection"] N -->|"normalized output ready"| U["Up projection + shared merge"] SD -->|"shared output ready"| U U --> O["Final TP sum"] ``` Panel handoffs apply to the front of K2; the final merge waits for the completed latent-normalization and shared-output stages. Cross-CTA handoffs use global/peer memory and readiness tags. Scratch and peer buffers are sized for M32. The diagrams show dependencies; actual overlap depends on the selected shape and worker schedule. ## Validation | Check | Result | |---|---| | K1 numerics, state updates and dispatch/fallback | 92 passed | | TP8 K2 numerics and K1/K2 graph replay | 10 passed | | Changed-file pre-commit, including mypy | Passed | | Diff checks | Passed | | GSM8K smoke, 64 samples, 5-shot, conc4/k5 | 61/64 (95.31%); no empty or truncated outputs | The 102 kernel/dispatch cases cover M24/M28/M30/M32, deep residual blocks, block resets, changed-input graph replay, scratch allocation and fallback above M32. The GSM8K smoke used an earlier candidate, seed 42, temperature 0, thinking disabled and a 4096-token output limit. Full-model accuracy equivalence of the current M32 revision remains pending.
Test commands ```bash .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -s tests/models/kimi_k3/test_amd_mono.py \ -k 'dispatch_falls_back or serving_dispatch or k1_matches_vllm_ops or kda_graph_replays_changed_state_slots' .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -s tests/models/kimi_k3/test_amd_mono.py \ -k 'k2_sparse_routes or k1_k2_serving_replays' ```

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Numerics of the Kimi-K3 mono decode kernels (``VLLM_ROCM_MONO_DECODE``) on MI355X
+against the ops vLLM runs for the same spec-verify step, random weights in the
+checkpoint's formats at TP8 shapes.
+
+- K1 (one GPU): AttnRes -> in_proj -> f_b -> conv -> KDA recurrence -> gated
+  norm, the conv / SSM state updates and a block-write layer's block store.
+- K2 and the standalone MoE launch (eight GPUs): o_proj + all-reduce + the MLP
+  AttnRes + the latent MoE, including independently computed reference routing.
+"""
+
+import pytest
+import ray
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+from einops import rearrange
+
+from tests.utils import (
+    init_test_distributed_environment,
+    multi_gpu_test,
+    multi_process_parallel,
+)
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+bf = torch.bfloat16
+COS_MIN = 0.9999
+
+
+def _on_gfx950() -> bool:
+    if not current_platform.is_rocm():
+        return False
+    from vllm.platforms.rocm import on_gfx950
+
+    return on_gfx950()
+
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not _on_gfx950(), reason="the K3 mono kernels need gfx950 (MI355X)"
+)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("rows", [24, 32, 33, 36, 40, 42, 48, 64])
+def test_mono_dispatch_falls_back_above_32_rows(monkeypatch, rows):
+    """Large batches must bypass both the mono decoder and K2 dispatch."""
+    from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd import linear, mono_decode
+
+    prefix = torch.zeros(rows, 8, dtype=bf)
+    blocks = torch.zeros(rows, 1, 8, dtype=bf)
+    expected = object()
+    calls = []
+
+    def mono(*args):
+        calls.append("mono")
+        return expected
+
+    def native(*args):
+        calls.append("native")
+        return expected
+
+    layer = SimpleNamespace(
+        _mono_kda=object(),
+        _mono_k2=None,
+        _forward_mono_kda=mono,
+        self_attn=object(),
+        self_attention_res_proj=None,
+        self_attention_res_norm=None,
+        prev_valid_blocks=1,
+        input_layernorm=None,
+        is_block_write_layer=False,
+        _run_self_attn=lambda positions, hidden: hidden,
+        _forward_mlp_residual=native,
+    )
+    monkeypatch.setattr(linear, "_apply_attn_res", lambda *args, **kwargs: prefix)
+    result = linear.KimiDecoderLayer.forward_attn_residual(
+        layer, torch.arange(rows), prefix, blocks, None
+    )
+    assert result is expected
+    assert calls == ["mono" if rows <= 32 else "native"]
+    assert mono_decode.MonoK2.eligible(None, prefix) == (rows <= 32)
+
+    metadata = SimpleNamespace(
+        spec_sequence_masks=torch.ones(rows, dtype=torch.bool),
+        num_prefills=0,
+        num_decodes=0,
+        num_spec_decodes=rows,
+        spec_state_indices_tensor=torch.zeros(rows, 1, dtype=torch.int32),
+        uniform_spec_sequence_length=1,
+        num_actual_tokens=rows,
+        num_accepted_tokens=torch.ones(rows, dtype=torch.int32),
+    )
+    assert mono_decode._spec_len(metadata, rows, prefix, None, blocks) == (
+        1 if rows <= 32 else None
+    )
+
+
+def _cos(a: torch.Tensor, b: torch.Tensor) -> float:
+    a, b = a.float().reshape(-1), b.float().reshape(-1)
+    return F.cosine_similarity(a, b, dim=0).item()
+
+
+def _rel_l2(a: torch.Tensor, b: torch.Tensor) -> float:
+    a, b = a.float(), b.float()
+    return ((a - b).norm() / b.norm()).item()
+
+
+def _randn(g, *shape, scale=1.0, dtype=bf):
+    return (torch.randn(*shape, generator=g, device=g.device) * scale).to(dtype)
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- K1
+
+
+def _kda_inputs(
+    nb: int, nacc: int, dim_first: bool, S: int, slots: int = 16, qlen: int = 8
+):
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.mono.attention.kda import (
+        HD,
+        HIDDEN,
+        NH,
+        NPROJ,
+        PROJ,
+        QKV,
+    )
+
+    g = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(0)
+    sl = 3 + (qlen - 1)
+    slots = max(slots, S + 8)
+    w = {
+        "prefix": _randn(g, S, HIDDEN, scale=2.0),
+        "delta": _randn(g, S, HIDDEN, scale=0.5),
+        "blocks": _randn(g, S, 8, HIDDEN, scale=2.0),
+        "ares_nw": (1 + _randn(g, HIDDEN, scale=0.1, dtype=torch.float32)).to(bf),
+        "ares_qk": _randn(g, HIDDEN, scale=0.05),
+        "in_nw": (1 + _randn(g, HIDDEN, scale=0.1, dtype=torch.float32)).to(bf),
+        "w_in": _randn(g, NPROJ, HIDDEN, scale=0.02),
+        "w_fb": _randn(g, PROJ, HD, scale=0.08),
+        "conv_w": _randn(g, QKV, 4, scale=0.4, dtype=torch.float32),
+        "a_log": _randn(g, NH, scale=0.5, dtype=torch.float32),
+        "dt_bias": _randn(g, PROJ, scale=0.5, dtype=torch.float32),
+        "on_w": (1 + _randn(g, HD, scale=0.1, dtype=torch.float32)).to(bf),
+    }
+    w["w_in"][NPROJ - 4 :].zero_()
+    # vLLM packs a layer's conv and SSM state in one padded page: strided slots
+    pad = _randn(g, slots, NH * HD * HD + 24576, scale=0.05, dtype=torch.float32)
+    w["rstate"] = pad[:, : NH * HD * HD].view(slots, NH, HD, HD)
+    conv = _randn(g, slots, QKV * sl + 4096)[:, : QKV * sl]
+    if dim_first:
+        w["conv_state"] = conv.view(slots, QKV, sl)
+    else:
+        w["conv_state"] = conv.view(slots, sl, QKV).transpose(-1, -2)
+    w["st_idx"] = torch.arange(3, 3 + S, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda").view(
+        S // qlen, qlen
+    )
+    w["num_acc"] = torch.full((S // qlen,), nacc, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+    if qlen < S:
+        w["num_acc"] = (
+            1 + torch.arange(S // qlen, device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32) % qlen
+        )
+    return w
+
+
+def _kda_reference(w, nb: int, S: int, write_idx: int, norm=None, inplace=False):
+    from vllm.config import VllmConfig, set_current_vllm_config
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.mamba.ops.causal_conv1d import (
+        causal_conv1d_update,
+    )
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.mono.attention.kda import HD, NH, PROJ, QKV
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.ops.attn_res import attn_res
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.ops.third_party.kda import fused_recurrent_kda
+    from vllm.third_party.flash_linear_attention.ops.kda import FusedRMSNormGated
+
+    prefix = w["prefix"] if inplace else w["prefix"].clone()
+    blocks = w["blocks"] if inplace else w["blocks"].clone()
+    x = attn_res(
+        prefix,
+        w["delta"],
+        blocks,
+        w["ares_nw"],
+        w["ares_qk"],
+        w["in_nw"],
+        nb,
+        write_idx,
+        1e-5,
+        1e-5,
+    )
+    proj = F.linear(x, w["w_in"])
+    mixed_qkv, g2, f_a, beta = proj.split([QKV, PROJ, HD, NH + 4], dim=-1)[:4]
+    g1 = F.linear(f_a, w["w_fb"])
+    conv_state = w["conv_state"] if inplace else w["conv_state"].clone()
+    rstate = w["rstate"] if inplace else w["rstate"].clone()
+    qlen = w["st_idx"].size(1)
+    qsl = torch.arange(0, S + 1, qlen, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+    conv = causal_conv1d_update(
+        mixed_qkv.contiguous(),
+        conv_state,
+        w["conv_w"],
+        None,
+        activation="silu",
+        conv_state_indices=w["st_idx"][:, 0].contiguous(),
+        num_accepted_tokens=w["num_acc"],
+        query_start_loc=qsl,
+        max_query_len=qlen,
+        validate_data=False,
+        out=torch.empty_like(mixed_qkv),
+    )
+    q, k, v = (
+        rearrange(t, "n (h d) -> 1 n h d", d=HD) for t in conv.split(PROJ, dim=-1)
+    )
+    core = torch.empty(1, S, NH, HD, dtype=bf, device="cuda")
+    fused_recurrent_kda(
+        q=q,
+        k=k,
+        v=v,
+        raw_g=rearrange(g1, "n (h d) -> 1 n h d", d=HD),
+        raw_beta=beta[:, :NH].unsqueeze(0),
+        A_log=w["a_log"],
+        dt_bias=w["dt_bias"],
+        lower_bound=-5.0,
+        initial_state=rstate,
+        cu_seqlens=qsl,
+        ssm_state_indices=w["st_idx"],
+        num_accepted_tokens=w["num_acc"],
+        uniform_sequence_length=qlen,
+        out=core,
+    )
+    if norm is None:
+        with set_current_vllm_config(VllmConfig()):
+            norm = FusedRMSNormGated(HD, activation="sigmoid").cuda()
+        norm.weight.data = w["on_w"].clone()
+    out = norm.forward_cuda(core, rearrange(g2, "n (h d) -> 1 n h d", d=HD))
+    return {
+        "prefix": prefix,
+        "blocks": blocks,
+        "conv_state": conv_state,
+        "rstate": rstate,
+        "core": out.reshape(S, PROJ),
+    }
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "dim_first,nacc,write,S,qlen,state_rows,pipeline",
+    [
+        (dim_first, nacc, write, 8, 8, 0, 0)

+def test_k1_matches_vllm_ops(
+    dim_first: bool,
+    nacc: int,
+    write: bool,
+    S: int,
+    qlen: int,
+    state_rows: int,
+    pipeline: int,
+) -> None:
+    """K1 against attn_res -> in_proj -> f_b -> causal_conv1d_update ->
+    fused_recurrent_kda -> FusedRMSNormGated on one spec-verify step (one
+    or more requests), including the state each step leaves behind."""
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.mono.attention.kda import (
+        PROJ,
+        KdaPreBuild,
+        kda_pre,
+        scratch_bytes,
+    )
+
+    nb = 4
+    # a block-write layer appends block nb (block_write_idx == prev_valid_blocks)
+    write_idx = nb if write else -1
+    w = _kda_inputs(nb, nacc, dim_first, S, qlen=qlen)
+    ref = _kda_reference(w, nb, S, write_idx)
+
+    key = KdaPreBuild(
+        tokens=S,
+        qlen=qlen,
+        nblocks=nb,
+        delta=True,
+        state_len=w["conv_state"].size(-1),
+        write_idx=write_idx,
+        state_rows=state_rows,
+        pipeline=pipeline,
+        head_workers=24 if pipeline & (1 << 26) else 16,
+    )
+    weight = w["w_in"]
+    if pipeline & 33554432:
+        from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.mono.attention.parallel import (
+            pack_projection_weights,
+        )
+
+        weight = pack_projection_weights(weight)
+    prefix, blocks = w["prefix"].clone(), w["blocks"].clone()
+    conv_state, rstate = w["conv_state"].clone(), w["rstate"].clone()
+    guarded = torch.full((S * PROJ + 512,), 123, dtype=bf, device="cuda")
+    core = guarded[256:-256].view(S, PROJ)
+    kda_pre(
+        key,
+        prefix=prefix,
+        delta=w["delta"],
+        blocks=blocks,
+        ares_nw=w["ares_nw"],
+        ares_qk=w["ares_qk"],
+        in_nw=w["in_nw"],
+        w_in=weight,
+        w_fb=w["w_fb"],
+        conv_w=w["conv_w"],
+        conv_state=conv_state,
+        a_log=w["a_log"],
+        dt_bias=w["dt_bias"],
+        on_w=w["on_w"],
+        rstate=rstate,
+        st_idx=w["st_idx"],
+        num_acc=w["num_acc"],
+        core_out=core,
+        scratch=torch.zeros(scratch_bytes(key), dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda"),
+        layer=0,
+        epoch=torch.ones(1, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda"),
+    )
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+
+    torch.testing.assert_close(prefix, ref["prefix"], atol=0, rtol=0)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(blocks, ref["blocks"], atol=0, rtol=0)
+    # the conv output feeds the recurrence in fp32 here, bf16 in the reference
+    errs = {
+        "conv_state": _rel_l2(conv_state, ref["conv_state"]),
+        "rstate": _rel_l2(rstate, ref["rstate"]),
+        "core": _rel_l2(core, ref["core"]),
+    }
+    assert errs["conv_state"] < 1e-3 and errs["rstate"] < 1e-3, errs
+    assert _cos(core, ref["core"]) > COS_MIN, errs
+    assert torch.all(
+        F.cosine_similarity(core.float(), ref["core"].float(), dim=1) > COS_MIN
+    )
+    assert torch.all(guarded[:256] == 123)
+    assert torch.all(guarded[-256:] == 123)
+    touched = w["st_idx"].flatten()
+    untouched = torch.ones(rstate.size(0), dtype=torch.bool, device="cuda")
+    untouched[touched] = False
+    torch.testing.assert_close(
+        rstate[untouched], w["rstate"][untouched], atol=0, rtol=0
+    )

+def _situ(g, u):
+    g, u = g.float(), u.float()
+    a = (2.0 * torch.tanh(g * 0.25)) * (1.0 + torch.tanh(g * 0.5))
+    return (a * (25.0 * torch.tanh(u * 0.04))).to(bf)
+
+
+def _all_reduce_fp32(t: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """The ranks' bf16 partials summed in fp32, as vLLM's custom all-reduce."""
+    t = t.float()
+    dist.all_reduce(t)
+    return t.to(bf)
+
+
+def _moe_reference(x, mw, rank: int):
+    """KimiMoE's decode path on ``x``: sigmoid router + bias top-16, the latent
+    down, aiter's MXFP4 experts, the latent all-reduce + RMSNorm, this rank's
+    up_proj rows into the shared experts' output, the final all-reduce."""
+    from aiter import ActivationType, QuantType
+    from aiter.fused_moe import fused_moe
+
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.mono.stages.moe import SI, TOPK, UP_N
+
+    sig = torch.sigmoid(torch.mm(x.float(), mw["w_gate"].float().t()))
+    ids = torch.topk(sig + mw["bias"], TOPK, dim=-1, sorted=True).indices
+    wts = sig.gather(-1, ids)
+    wts = wts / wts.sum(-1, keepdim=True)
+    gu = F.linear(x, mw["w_sgu"])
+    shared = F.linear(_situ(gu[:, :SI], gu[:, SI:]), mw["w_sd"])
+    y = fused_moe(
+        F.linear(x, mw["w_ld"]),
+        mw["w13"],
+        mw["w2"],
+        wts.float(),
+        ids.to(torch.int32),
+        None,
+        ActivationType.Situv2,
+        QuantType.per_1x32,
+        False,
+        mw["w13s"],
+        mw["w2s"],
+        None,
+        None,
+        dtype=bf,
+        gate_mode="separated",
+        beta=4.0,
+        linear_beta=25.0,
+    )
+    lat = _all_reduce_fp32(y).float()
+    ln = lat * torch.rsqrt(lat.pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True) + 1e-5) * mw["ln_w"]
+    lo = rank * UP_N
+    up = ln.to(bf).float() @ mw["w_up_shard"].float().t()
+    shared[:, lo : lo + UP_N] = (shared[:, lo : lo + UP_N].float() + up).to(bf)
+    return _all_reduce_fp32(shared)
+

+def _moe_weights(rank: int, device):
+    from aiter.utility.fp4_utils import e8m0_shuffle
+
+    from vllm._aiter_ops import rocm_aiter_ops
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.mono.stages.moe import HIDDEN, LAT, RI, SI, UP_N, E
+
+    gc = torch.Generator(device=device).manual_seed(7)  # replicated weights
+    gr = torch.Generator(device=device).manual_seed(100 + rank)  # TP shards
+
+    def u8(g, *shape, lo=0, hi=256):
+        return torch.randint(
+            lo, hi, shape, generator=g, device=device, dtype=torch.uint8
+        )
+
+    fp4, e8 = torch.float4_e2m1fn_x2, torch.float8_e8m0fnu
+    w_up = _randn(gc, HIDDEN, LAT, scale=0.02)
+    return {
+        "w_gate": _randn(gc, E, HIDDEN, scale=0.02),
+        "bias": _randn(gc, E, scale=0.02, dtype=torch.float32),
+        "w_ld": _randn(gc, LAT, HIDDEN, scale=0.02),
+        "ln_w": (1 + _randn(gc, LAT, scale=0.1, dtype=torch.float32)).to(bf),
+        "w_up_shard": w_up[rank * UP_N : (rank + 1) * UP_N].contiguous(),
+        "w_sgu": _randn(gr, 2 * SI, HIDDEN, scale=0.02),
+        "w_sd": _randn(gr, HIDDEN, SI, scale=0.03),
+        "w13": rocm_aiter_ops.shuffle_weight_a16w4(
+            u8(gr, E, 2 * RI, LAT // 2).view(fp4), 16, False
+        ),
+        "w2": rocm_aiter_ops.shuffle_weight_a16w4(
+            u8(gr, E, LAT, RI // 2).view(fp4), 16, False
+        ),
+        "w13s": rocm_aiter_ops.shuffle_scale_a16w4(
+            u8(gr, E, 2 * RI, LAT // 32, lo=118, hi=123).view(e8).view(-1, LAT // 32),
+            E,
+            False,
+        ),
+        "w2s": e8m0_shuffle(
+            u8(gr, E, LAT, RI // 32, lo=118, hi=123).view(e8).view(-1, RI // 32)
+        ),
+    }
+
+
+def _moe_args(mw):
+    return {
+        "w_gate": mw["w_gate"],
+        "bias": mw["bias"],
+        "w_ld": mw["w_ld"],
+        "w_sgu": mw["w_sgu"],
+        "w_sd": mw["w_sd"],
+        "w13": mw["w13"],
+        "w13s": mw["w13s"],
+        "w2": mw["w2"],
+        "w2s": mw["w2s"],
+        "ln_w": mw["ln_w"],
+        "w_up": mw["w_up_shard"],

+def _dcp_mla_core(S, generator, backend):
+    """Exercise weighted context merging and the BF16 V-up/gate handoff to K2."""
+    from vllm.distributed import get_dcp_group
+    from vllm.v1.attention.ops.dcp import cp_lse_ag_out_rs, dcp_a2a_lse_reduce
+
+    group = get_dcp_group()
+    size, rank = group.world_size, group.rank_in_group
+    heads, latent, width = 12, 512, 128
+    partial = _randn(generator, S, heads * size, latent)
+    lse = _randn(generator, S, heads * size, scale=2.0, dtype=torch.float32)
+    lse.add_(rank * 1.5)
+    lengths = torch.ones(S, dtype=torch.int32, device=generator.device)
+    if rank == 0:
+        lengths[0] = 0
+        lse[0].fill_(float("nan"))
+    lengths[1] = 0
+    lse[1].fill_(float("nan"))
+    starts = torch.arange(S + 1, dtype=torch.int32, device=generator.device)
+    w_v = _randn(generator, heads, latent, width, scale=0.05)
+    gate = _randn(generator, S, heads * width).sigmoid()
+    combine = cp_lse_ag_out_rs if backend == "ag_rs" else dcp_a2a_lse_reduce
+
+    def forward():
+        # AG+RS normalizes its input in place, so reset it on every replay.
+        merged = combine(
+            partial.clone(),
+            lse.clone(),
+            group,
+            seq_lens=lengths,
+            query_start_loc=starts,
+        )
+        projected = torch.bmm(merged.transpose(0, 1), w_v).transpose(0, 1)
+        return merged, projected.reshape(S, heads * width) * gate
+
+    def check(merged, core):
+        outputs = [torch.empty_like(partial) for _ in range(size)]
+        lses = [torch.empty_like(lse) for _ in range(size)]
+        masked_lse = lse.masked_fill(lengths[:, None] == 0, -torch.inf)
+        dist.all_gather(outputs, partial, group=group.device_group)
+        dist.all_gather(lses, masked_lse, group=group.device_group)
+        logs = torch.stack(lses)
+        maximum = logs.amax(dim=0)
+        maximum = torch.where(torch.isfinite(maximum), maximum, 0.0)
+        weights = (logs - maximum).exp()
+        weights /= weights.sum(dim=0).clamp_min(1e-30)
+        reference = (torch.stack(outputs).float() * weights[..., None]).sum(dim=0)
+        reference = reference[:, rank * heads : (rank + 1) * heads]
+        assert torch.isfinite(merged).all()
+        assert torch.count_nonzero(merged[1]) == 0
+        assert _rel_l2(merged, reference) < 0.01
+        projected = torch.bmm(reference.to(bf).transpose(0, 1), w_v).transpose(0, 1)
+        expected = projected.reshape(S, heads * width) * gate
+        assert _cos(core, expected) > COS_MIN
+
+    for _ in range(2):
+        merged, core = forward()
+    check(merged, core)
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+    dist.barrier()
+    graph = None
+    if backend == "ag_rs":
+        graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+        with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+            merged, core = forward()
+    # ProcessGroupNCCL A2A work.wait() queries a captured HIP event on this
+    # backend. Keep its eager handoff covered without claiming graph support.
+    for change in (0.0, 0.25, -0.5):
+        partial.add_(change * (rank + 1))
+        lse.add_(change * (rank + 1))
+        if graph is None:
+            merged, core = forward()
+        else:
+            graph.replay()
+        torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+        check(merged, core)
+    return core.clone()
+

+def _k2_worker(
+    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
+    tp_size: int,
+    pp_size: int,
+    rank: int,
+    distributed_init_port: str,
+    S: int = 8,
+    shared_down_workers: int = 0,
+    latent_quant_workers: int = 0,
+    dcp_size: int = 1,
+    dcp_backend: str = "ag_rs",
+    producer_latent_quant: bool = False,
+    down_workers: int = 0,
+    bounded_prefetch: bool = False,
+    stream_oproj: bool = False,
+    balanced_oproj: bool = False,
+    sparse_routes: bool = False,
+    nblocks: int = 4,
+    front_panels: bool = False,
+) -> None:
+    monkeypatch.delenv("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES", raising=False)
+    device = torch.device(f"cuda:{rank}")
+    torch.accelerator.set_device_index(device)
+    if dcp_size == 1:
+        init_test_distributed_environment(tp_size, pp_size, rank, distributed_init_port)
+    else:
+        from vllm.config import ParallelConfig, VllmConfig, set_current_vllm_config
+        from vllm.distributed import (
+            ensure_model_parallel_initialized,
+            init_distributed_environment,
+        )
+
+        config = VllmConfig(
+            parallel_config=ParallelConfig(
+                tensor_parallel_size=tp_size,
+                decode_context_parallel_size=dcp_size,
+            )
+        )
+        with set_current_vllm_config(config):
+            init_distributed_environment(
+                world_size=tp_size,
+                rank=rank,
+                local_rank=rank,
+                distributed_init_method=f"tcp://localhost:{distributed_init_port}",
+                backend="nccl",
+            )
+            ensure_model_parallel_initialized(
+                tp_size, pp_size, decode_context_model_parallel_size=dcp_size
+            )
+
+    from vllm.distributed import get_tp_group
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.mono import layer as k2
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.mono import runner
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.mono.attention.kda import HIDDEN, PROJ
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.mono.common.peer_memory import PeerBuffer
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.mono.stages import moe
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.ops.attn_res import attn_res
+
+    nb = nblocks
+    tp = get_tp_group()
+    peers = PeerBuffer(
+        max(k2.peer_bytes(S), moe.peer_bytes(S)), tp.cpu_group, rank, tp_size, device
+    )
+    peers.bytes.zero_()
+    epoch = torch.zeros(1, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+    mw = _moe_weights(rank, device)
+    gc = torch.Generator(device=device).manual_seed(11)
+    gr = torch.Generator(device=device).manual_seed(200 + rank)
+    core = _randn(gr, S, PROJ)
+    if dcp_size > 1:
+        core = _dcp_mla_core(S, gr, dcp_backend)
+    w_o = _randn(gr, HIDDEN, PROJ, scale=0.02)
+    prefix0 = _randn(gc, S, HIDDEN, scale=2.0)
+    blocks = _randn(gc, S, 8, HIDDEN, scale=2.0)
+    ares_nw = (1 + _randn(gc, HIDDEN, scale=0.1, dtype=torch.float32)).to(bf)
+    ares_qk = _randn(gc, HIDDEN, scale=0.05)
+    in_nw = (1 + _randn(gc, HIDDEN, scale=0.1, dtype=torch.float32)).to(bf)
+
+    for reset in (False, True):
+        epoch.add_(1)
+        key = k2.K2Build(
+            tokens=S,
+            nblocks=nb + int(reset),
+            reset=reset,
+            shared_down_workers=shared_down_workers,
+            parallel_shared_activation=shared_down_workers > 0,
+            late_shared_wait=shared_down_workers > 0,
+            latent_quant_workers=latent_quant_workers,
+            producer_latent_quant=producer_latent_quant,
+            down_workers=down_workers,
+            full_shared_pipeline=down_workers > 0 and shared_down_workers > 0,
+            down_batch=2 if bounded_prefetch else 5,
+            inter_vec=2 if bounded_prefetch else 1,
+            stream_oproj=stream_oproj,
+            trim_oproj=stream_oproj,
+            balanced_oproj=balanced_oproj,
+            wide=sparse_routes,
+            compact_lds=sparse_routes,
+            sparse_routes=sparse_routes,
+            cache_wide_inter=sparse_routes,
+            stream_attn=sparse_routes and nb + int(reset) >= 8,
+            stream_x=front_panels,
+            front_panels=front_panels,
+        )
+        runner.alloc_scratch(device)
+        assert k2.scratch_bytes(key) <= runner.scratch_bytes()
+        scratch = runner.scratch()
+        prefix = prefix0.clone()
+        out = torch.empty(S, HIDDEN, dtype=bf, device=device)
+        k2.k2_launch(
+            key,
+            core=core,
+            w_o=w_o,
+            prefix=prefix,
+            blocks=blocks,
+            ares_nw=ares_nw,
+            ares_qk=ares_qk,
+            in_nw=in_nw,
+            out=out,
+            scratch=scratch,
+            peers=peers.addresses,
+            rank=rank,
+            epoch=epoch,
+            layer=3,
+            **_moe_args(mw),
+        )
+        torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+
+        attn = _all_reduce_fp32(F.linear(core, w_o))
+        # a block-write layer's prefix restarts at the attention output
+        ref_prefix = attn if reset else prefix0.clone()
+        delta = None if reset else attn
+        x_ref = attn_res(
+            ref_prefix,
+            delta,
+            blocks,
+            ares_nw,
+            ares_qk,
+            in_nw,
+            nb + int(reset),
+            -1,
+            1e-5,
+            1e-5,
+        )
+        # the kernel sums the ranks in rank order, NCCL in its own order
+        assert _rel_l2(prefix, ref_prefix) < 1e-2
+        offset = k2.scratch_layout(key)["xrow"][0]
+        x = scratch[offset : offset + S * HIDDEN * 2].view(bf).view(S, HIDDEN)
+        assert _cos(x, x_ref) > COS_MIN
+        assert _cos(out, _moe_reference(x, mw, rank)) > COS_MIN
+        assert _cos(out, _moe_reference(x_ref, mw, rank)) > COS_MIN
+        outs = [torch.empty_like(out) for _ in range(tp_size)]
+        dist.all_gather(outs, out)
+        assert all(torch.equal(outs[0], o) for o in outs), "ranks disagree"
+
+        if front_panels:
+
+            def launch(key=key, prefix=prefix, out=out, scratch=scratch):
+                prefix.copy_(prefix0)
+                epoch.add_(1)
+                k2.k2_launch(
+                    key,
+                    core=core,
+                    w_o=w_o,
+                    prefix=prefix,
+                    blocks=blocks,
+                    ares_nw=ares_nw,
+                    ares_qk=ares_qk,
+                    in_nw=in_nw,
+                    out=out,
+                    scratch=scratch,
+                    peers=peers.addresses,
+                    rank=rank,
+                    epoch=epoch,
+                    layer=3,
+                    **_moe_args(mw),
+                )
+
+            graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+            dist.barrier()
+            with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+                launch()
+            for change in (0.125, -0.25):
+                core.add_(change * (rank + 1))
+                prefix0.add_(change)
+                launch()
+                expected_out, expected_prefix = out.clone(), prefix.clone()
+                graph.replay()
+                torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+                torch.testing.assert_close(out, expected_out, rtol=0, atol=0)
+                torch.testing.assert_close(prefix, expected_prefix, rtol=0, atol=0)
+            del graph
+
+    if S > moe.MOE_TILE_TOKENS:
+        peers.close()
+        return
+
+    # the standalone MoE launch (a layer K2 does not serve)
+    epoch.add_(1)
+    x = _randn(gc, S, HIDDEN)
+    out = torch.empty_like(x)
+    queue = torch.zeros(moe.QUEUE_BYTES // 4, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+    moe.moe(
+        moe.MoeBuild(tokens=S),
+        x=x,
+        out=out,
+        scratch=torch.zeros(
+            moe.scratch_bytes(moe.MoeBuild(tokens=S)), dtype=torch.uint8, device=device
+        ),
+        queue=queue,
+        peers=peers.addresses,
+        rank=rank,
+        epoch=epoch,
+        layer=128 + 3,
+        **_moe_args(mw),
+    )
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+    assert _cos(out, _moe_reference(x, mw, rank)) > COS_MIN
+    peers.close()

+# Kimi-K3 mono decode (MI355X)
+
+Enable with `VLLM_ROCM_MONO_DECODE=1` on TP8, gfx950. This experimental
+extension is based on #60683 at `9c6c96d8ef`, before its shared MonoKernel
+runtime refactor. Its serving results do not apply to that PR's current head.
+
+K1 covers AttnRes, input projection, f_b, speculative convolution, KDA
+recurrence and gated RMSNorm. K2 covers output projection, the TP reduction,
+MLP AttnRes, routed and shared experts, latent reduction and RMSNorm, up
+projection and the final TP reduction. MLA's attention and DCP output merge
+finish before K2 consumes the local output; this implementation does not fuse
+the MLA prologue or epilogue.
+
+## Serving selection
+
+| Rows in the step | Selected implementation |
+| --- | --- |
+| 1–16 | K2; eligible KDA steps with verification lengths 2, 4, 6 or 8 use the combined K1/K2 schedule outside FULL graphs |
+| 18, 20, 24 | K2 with sparse expert routing and compact LDS |
+| 28, 30, 32 | K2 also streams projection panels to their consumers |
+| Other widths | Existing projection and AITER MoE path; KDA can use an eligible K1 path only through 32 rows |
+
+The scope is conc4 verification, including four requests with up to eight
+verification tokens each (M32). Dispatch uses the model step's row count,
+not the client's concurrency setting. AgenticX session concurrency can admit
+more than four simultaneous HTTP requests; any step above M32 falls back.
+K1, K2 and post-projection KDA all stop at M32. M30/M32 KDA retains the
+production input projection before post-projection fusion. Prefill, mixed
+steps, unsupported layouts and unsupported graph metadata retain their
+existing eligibility checks.
+
+## Data and worker scheduling
+
+K1 processes complete requests in token tiles, stages input columns in bounded
+LDS slices, and retains projection accumulators across those slices. Selected
+small shapes pack projection weights once and use separate worker assignments
+for projection and recurrence. Compiled callables and stable argument tuples
+are cached. Captured argument-table copies retain their immutable pinned host
+storage for subsequent graph replays; state indices, accepted counts and epochs
+remain runtime inputs.
+
+The combined small-row schedule reuses workers as K1 output becomes ready.
+Epoch-tagged handoffs prevent K2 from consuming incomplete local output, and
+the TP reductions wait for the corresponding peer data. Experimental reserved
+worker and ring-buffer schedules remain available to the benchmark; serving
+selects the worker-reuse schedule.
+
+Wide K2 uses compact routing metadata and a sparse expert-pick list. It keeps
+expert intermediates in LDS through 32 rows. From 28 rows, projection consumers
+advance after their input panel is ready. The M48 shared-expert and tail-panel
+schedules have been removed; scratch and peer buffers cover the retained
+shapes through M32.
+
+## Compatibility and validation
+
+Full mono is disabled with a KV connector. Local post-projection fusion has
+separate eligibility checks; the serialized-offload K1 experiment additionally
+requires an explicit connector option. Neither changes the default offload
+gate. FULL-only graph metadata is excluded from these KDA fusion paths.
+
+The numerical suite is `tests/models/kimi_k3/test_amd_mono.py`, including
+state/reset checks and changed-input graph replay. Full-model accuracy
+equivalence is not established by kernel-level checks.
+
+Historical AgenticX conc4/k5 results with the broader rev023 graph-fixed
+candidate measured 190.84 output tok/s versus 181.91 for the original #60683
+snapshot (+4.91%), and p90 interactivity of 146.53 versus 123.45 tok/s (+18.70%).
+These were single 3600-second runs on different machines (Crusoe control, AAC
+candidate), with synthetic acceptance length 3.62, seed 42, TP8, GPU KV and
+FULL_AND_PIECEWISE graphs. They do not isolate the kernel effect or establish
+performance of the M32-limited revision: the historical recipe admitted eight
+HTTP requests and graph sizes through M48. The M32
+revision needs a new serving measurement before reusing those gains as a claim.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

+"""K2a ``attn_post``: one Kimi-K3 KDA layer from the gated core output to the
+MoE's input row -- o_proj, its TP all-reduce inside the kernel, and the MLP
+AttnRes seam.
+
+One launch a layer and rank, ``BLOCKS`` x ``THREADS``:
+
+    gemv CTAs 56 ..   o_proj (448 x 16 rows, K = 1536 local): bf16 GEMV of the
+                      core rows (plain loads: the previous launch wrote them) ->
+                      bf16 partial -> pushed to every rank's AR region (system
+                      scope, this rank's slot)
+    attn CTAs 0 .. 55 per 128 columns: the 8 ranks' partials summed in rank
+                      order (fp32 -> bf16: the custom all-reduce's result) ->
+                      LDS delta; then K1's AttnRes stages with the MLP's weights:
+                      prefix + delta -> prefix out, the sources' softmax mix,
+                      post_attention_layernorm -> the MoE input x
+
+The AR region is double-buffered by the step epoch's parity: a rank a step
+ahead writes the other half, so no peer's unread partials are overwritten.
+"""
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+import flydsl.compiler as flyc
+import flydsl.expr as fx
+import torch
+from aiter.ops.flydsl.kernels import buffer_ops as bo
+from flydsl.expr import const_expr, gpu, range_constexpr
+from flydsl.expr.typing import Int32, Int64, T
+
+from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.mono.attention.kda import (
+    _SOURCES,
+    COLS,
+    HIDDEN,
+    LDS_PAD,
+    NA,
+    PROJ,
+    ROWS,
+    stage_gate,
+    stage_mix,
+    stage_slice,
+    step_tag,
+)
+from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.mono.common.debug import stamp, stamp_begin, stamp_flush
+from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.mono.common.ops import (
+    CM_NT,
+    bf16_round,
+    ld_i32,
+    mfma_bf16,
+    row_sum,
+    rsrc,
+    traced,
+    uniform,
+)
+from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.mono.common.plan import (
+    BLOCKS,
+    THREADS,
+    WAVES,
+    KernelAbi,
+    key_tuple,
+    pair_layout,
+)
+from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.mono.common.ranks import peer_bases, sum_partials
+from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.mono.common.sync import Mailbox, preg, shift, sreg
+
+TP = 8
+OROWS = HIDDEN  # o_proj rows (full hidden, a rank's K slice)
+OTASKS = OROWS // ROWS  # 448
+OK = PROJ  # K = 1536 a rank
+OKCH = OK // 128  # 12 chunks
+GEMV0 = NA  # the first gemv CTA
+GEMV_N = BLOCKS - NA  # 200
+TL_POINTS = 6  # start, gemv, pushed, reduced, slice/gate, mix
+
+_STREAM = fx.Stream(None)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class AttnPostBuild:
+    tokens: int
+    nblocks: int  # the MLP AttnRes block sources
+    eps: float = 1e-5
+    out_eps: float = 1e-5
+    timeline: bool = False
+
+
+ABI = KernelAbi(
+    (
+        "core",
+        "w_o",
+        "prefix",
+        "blocks",
+        "blk_sm",
+        "blk_sr",
+        "ares_nw",
+        "ares_qk",
+        "in_nw",
+        "x_out",
+        "scratch",
+        "peers",
+        "rank",
+        "epoch",
+        "layer",
+        "tl",
+    )
+)
+
+
+def ar_half_pairs(s):
+    """One parity's AR region: [src rank][token][column pair]."""
+    return TP * s * HIDDEN // 2
+
+
+def peer_bytes(max_tokens):
+    return 2 * ar_half_pairs(max_tokens) * 8
+
+
+def scratch_layout(key: AttnPostBuild) -> dict:
+    s, ns = key.tokens, key.nblocks + 1
+    pairs = {
+        "part": NA * s * ns * 2,
+        "wgt": s * (ns + 1),
+        "msq": NA * s,
+        "xrdy": NA,
+    }
+    return pair_layout(pairs.items())
+
+
+def scratch_bytes(key: AttnPostBuild) -> int:
+    return max(o + n for o, n in scratch_layout(key).values())
+
+
+def o_loads(c, rg):
+    """Rows 16 rg .. of o_proj, this wave's K chunks (wave, wave + 8 < 12): a lane
+    64 B of its row a chunk."""
+    lane, wave = c["lane"], c["wave"]
+    r_w = rsrc(c["args"]["w_o"])
+    row = rg * ROWS + lane % ROWS
+    g = lane // ROWS
+    out = []
+    for i in range(2):
+        ch = fx.min(wave + WAVES * i, OKCH - 1)
+        base = (row * OK + ch * 128 + g * 8) // 2
+        out.append(
+            [
+                fx.Vector(
+                    bo.buffer_load(
+                        r_w,
+                        base + 16 * q,
+                        vec_width=4,
+                        dtype=T.i32,
+                        cache_modifier=CM_NT,
+                    )
+                )
+                for q in range(4)
+            ]
+        )
+    return out
+
+
+@traced
+def load_core(c):
+    """The core rows (S x 1536 bf16) -> LDS, rows padded."""
+    s, tid = c["S"], c["tid"]
+    rows, first = c.get("panel_rows", s), c.get("panel_first", 0)
+    words = rows * OK // 8
+    row = OK + LDS_PAD
+    for i in range_constexpr((words + THREADS - 1) // THREADS):
+        e = fx.min(tid + THREADS * i, words - 1)
+        if const_expr(c.get("core_mailbox") is not None):
+            values = c["poll"](
+                [(c["core_mailbox"], first * OK // 2 + e * 4 + q, 1) for q in range(4)]
+            )
+            v = fx.Vector.from_elements([value[0] for value in values], fx.Int32)
+        else:
+            v = fx.Vector(
+                bo.buffer_load(
+                    rsrc(c["args"]["core"]),
+                    first * OK // 2 + e * 4,
+                    vec_width=4,
+                    dtype=T.i32,
+                )
+            )
+        t = e // (OK // 8)

+@traced

+    s, lane, wave = c["S"], c["lane"], c["wave"]

+        k = fx.min(ch, OKCH - 1) * 128 + g * 8

+"""K1 ``kda_pre``: one Kimi-K3 KDA layer from the AttnRes seam to the gated core
+output, for a spec-verify step (R requests x L tokens, S = R L rows).
+
+One launch a layer, ``BLOCKS`` CTAs x ``THREADS`` threads, in three roles so that
+no CTA that polls a mailbox has weight loads in flight (a poll's load retires
+behind every earlier load):
+
+    attn CTAs 0 .. 55   slice (128 hidden columns each): prefix (+ delta) ->
+                        bf16 prefix out, per-source partial sum of squares and
+                        qk dot (PART); gate (token t on CTA t): softmax weights
+                        (WGT); mix: the softmax mix, its partial sum of squares
+                        (MSQ), every slice's -> output RMSNorm -> bf16 x rows
+                        (plain device-scope stores, an XRDY flag a slice)
+    gemv CTAs 56 ..     in_proj, two 16-row groups each: the first group's
+                        weights issued at kernel start, the second's as x lands
+                        -> q|k|v|g|f_a|beta (PROJ)
+    kda tasks           (R x 12 heads x 8 v-chunks) on CTAs 0 ..: inputs that
+                        need no hand-off loaded first (metadata, conv window,
+                        state rows, f_b rows), then conv update of the owned
+                        channels (q / k out through QK), f_b MFMA + lower-bound
+                        gate, l2norm, the recurrence on 16 state rows (a state a
+                        token written), partial norms (ONRM), gated RMSNorm ->
+                        core_out
+
+Rounding follows the original path where it is elementwise (the AttnRes prefix
+add, every bf16 hand-off between the original kernels); split-K reductions
+differ only in their order.
+"""

+    if key.state_rows == 0:

+    s, ns = key.tokens, key.nblocks + 1

+TAG_SLOTS = 256  # a step's mailbox tags: epoch x 256 + a launch's slot

+def step_tag(epoch, slot):
+    """This launch's mailbox tag: the step's epoch (a device counter the runner
+    bumps once a step, in the graph) and the launch's slot, so no step's or
+    other launch's pair ever passes for this one's -- nothing is zeroed."""
+    e = uniform(ld_i32(epoch, 0))

+def ld_bf(ptr, i, cm=0):
+    return fx.Float32(
+        fx.BFloat16(
+            bo.buffer_load(rsrc(ptr), i, vec_width=1, dtype=T.bf16, cache_modifier=cm)

+def stage_slice(c, task):

+    a = c["args"]

+        e = fx.min(tid + THREADS * i, n - 1)
+        live = (tid + THREADS * i) < n
+        row = e // QC  # (token, source)
+        t = row // ns
+        src = row % ns
+        col = c0 + (e % QC) * 4
+        is_pre = src == nb
+        blk = ld_bf4(
+            a["blocks"], t * a["blk_sm"] + fx.min(src, nb - 1) * a["blk_sr"] + col
+        )
+        pre = ld_bf4(a["prefix"], t * HIDDEN + col)
+        if const_expr(c["delta"]):
+            if const_expr(c.get("delta_lds") is not None):
+                # the delta reduced into LDS first (K2a: the all-reduced o_proj)
+                dl = [
+                    fx.ptr_load(c["delta_lds"] + (t * COLS + (e % QC) * 4 + j))
+                    for j in range(4)
+                ]
+            else:
+                dl = ld_bf4(a["delta"], t * HIDDEN + col)
+            if const_expr(c.get("reset", False)):
+                # a block-write layer's MLP seam: the prefix restarts at the
+                # attention's output (the input prefix is not read)
+                pre = dl
+            else:
+                pre = [bf16r(pre[j] + dl[j]) for j in range(4)]
+            if live & is_pre:
+                bo.buffer_store(
+                    bf4_words(pre),
+                    rsrc(a["prefix"]),
+                    (t * HIDDEN + col) // 2,
+                    cache_modifier=CM_DEV if stream else 0,
+                )
+        if const_expr(c.get("write_idx", -1) >= 0):  # noqa: SIM102 (traced: `and` does not combine traced values)
+            # the block-write layer's attention seam: the updated prefix is
+            # block write_idx
+            if live & is_pre:
+                bo.buffer_store(
+                    bf4_words(pre),
+                    rsrc(a["blocks"]),
+                    (t * a["blk_sm"] + c["write_idx"] * a["blk_sr"] + col) // 2,
+                )
+        v = [
+            live.select(is_pre.select(pre[j], blk[j]), fx.Float32(0.0))
+            for j in range(4)
+        ]
+        w = ld_bf4(a["ares_nw"], col)
+        q = ld_bf4(a["ares_qk"], col)
+        # a thread past the end holds a clamped copy of the last element: it
+        # must not store (it raced the owner with zeros)
+        if const_expr(not stream):  # noqa: SIM102
+            if live:
+                for j in range_constexpr(4):
+                    fx.ptr_store(v[j], c["vals"] + (row * COLS + (e % QC) * 4 + j))
+        sq = v[0] * v[0] + v[1] * v[1] + v[2] * v[2] + v[3] * v[3]
+        dt = (
+            v[0] * (w[0] * q[0])
+            + v[1] * (w[1] * q[1])
+            + v[2] * (w[2] * q[2])
+            + v[3] * (w[3] * q[3])
+        )
+        sq = butterfly(sq, (16, 8, 4, 2, 1))
+        dt = butterfly(dt, (16, 8, 4, 2, 1))
+        if live & (lane % 32 == 0):
+            at = ((task * s + t) * ns + src) * 2
+            c["put"](c["part"], at, sq)
+            c["put"](c["part"], at + 1, dt)
+    if const_expr(stream):
+        rocdl.s_waitcnt(vmcnt=0)
+    gpu.barrier()
+

+@traced
+def stage_gate(c, t):
+    """Token t: the 56 slices' partials -> source weights e_s and their sum."""
+    s, ns, tid, lane, wave, red = (
+        c["S"],
+        c["NS"],
+        c["tid"],
+        c["lane"],
+        c["wave"],
+        c["red"],
+    )
+    nq = ns * 2
+    if tid < 8 * nq:
+        g = tid // nq
+        q = tid % nq
+        vals = c["poll"](
+            [(c["part"], (((g * GSL + k) * s + t) * ns) * 2 + q, 1) for k in range(GSL)]
+        )
+        fx.ptr_store(sum_polled(vals), red + (g * nq + q))
+    gpu.barrier()
+    if wave == 0:
+        src = fx.min(lane, ns - 1)
+        sq = fx.ptr_load(red + src * 2)
+        dt = fx.ptr_load(red + src * 2 + 1)
+        for g in range_constexpr(1, 8):
+            sq = sq + fx.ptr_load(red + (g * nq + src * 2))
+            dt = dt + fx.ptr_load(red + (g * nq + src * 2 + 1))
+        rstd = hw_rsq(sq * fx.Float32(1.0 / HIDDEN) + fx.Float32(c["eps"]))
+        logit = dt * rstd * fx.Float32(LOG2E)
+        logit = (lane < ns).select(logit, fx.Float32(-3.0e38))
+        m = wave_max(logit)
+        ex = (lane < ns).select(hw_exp2(logit - m), fx.Float32(0.0))
+        den = butterfly(ex, (32, 16, 8, 4, 2, 1))
+        if lane < ns:
+            c["put"](c["wgt"], t * (ns + 1) + lane, ex)
+        if lane == 0:
+            c["put"](c["wgt"], t * (ns + 1) + ns, den)
+    gpu.barrier()
+

+GATE_OFF = 512  # red words of stage_gate_local's group sums
+

+@traced
+def stage_gate_local(c):
+    """Every token's source weights computed in this CTA (``stage_gate``'s sums
+    in its order, so every CTA's are bit-identical): the 56 slices' partials
+    polled in one round trip (no gate CTA, no WGT hand-off) -> red[t (ns + 1)
+    + src], the sum at + ns."""
+    s, ns, tid, lane, wave, red = (
+        c["S"],
+        c["NS"],
+        c["tid"],
+        c["lane"],
+        c["wave"],
+        c["red"],
+    )
+    nq = ns * 2
+    n = 8 * s * nq  # (group, token, partial) items
+    per = (n + THREADS - 1) // THREADS
+    specs = []
+    for r in range_constexpr(per):
+        item = fx.min(tid + THREADS * r, n - 1)
+        g = item // (s * nq)
+        t = (item // nq) % s
+        q = item % nq
+        specs += [
+            (c["part"], (((g * GSL + k) * s + t) * ns) * 2 + q, 1) for k in range(GSL)
+        ]
+    got = c["poll"](specs, per * GSL)
+    for r in range_constexpr(per):
+        acc = f32_of(got[r * GSL][0])
+        for k in range_constexpr(1, GSL):
+            acc = acc + f32_of(got[r * GSL + k][0])
+        if tid + THREADS * r < n:
+            fx.ptr_store(acc, red + (GATE_OFF + tid + THREADS * r))
+    gpu.barrier()
+    # wave t: token t's weights (stage_gate's math)
+    if wave < s:
+        t = wave
+        src = fx.min(lane, ns - 1)
+        base = GATE_OFF + t * nq
+        sq = fx.ptr_load(red + (base + src * 2))
+        dt = fx.ptr_load(red + (base + src * 2 + 1))
+        for g in range_constexpr(1, 8):
+            sq = sq + fx.ptr_load(red + (base + g * s * nq + src * 2))
+            dt = dt + fx.ptr_load(red + (base + g * s * nq + src * 2 + 1))
+        rstd = hw_rsq(sq * fx.Float32(1.0 / HIDDEN) + fx.Float32(c["eps"]))
+        logit = dt * rstd * fx.Float32(LOG2E)
+        logit = (lane < ns).select(logit, fx.Float32(-3.0e38))
+        m = wave_max(logit)
+        ex = (lane < ns).select(hw_exp2(logit - m), fx.Float32(0.0))
+        den = butterfly(ex, (32, 16, 8, 4, 2, 1))
+        if lane < ns:
+            fx.ptr_store(ex, red + (t * (ns + 1) + lane))
+        if lane == 0:
+            fx.ptr_store(den, red + (t * (ns + 1) + ns))
+    gpu.barrier()

+@traced
+def stage_mix_streamed(c, task):
+    """Publish each normalized token panel before mixing the following panel."""
+    s, ns, tid, lane, red = c["S"], c["NS"], c["tid"], c["lane"], c["red"]
+    a = c["args"]
+    stream = c.get("stream_attn", False)
+    mixed_stride = COLS if stream else ns * COLS
+    norm = red + s * (ns + 1)
+    for i in range_constexpr((s * (ns + 1) + THREADS - 1) // THREADS):
+        at = tid + i * THREADS
+        if at < s * (ns + 1):
+            value = c["poll"]([(c["wgt"], at, 1)])[0][0]
+            fx.ptr_store(f32_of(value), red + at)
+    gpu.barrier()
+    for first in range_constexpr(0, s, 16):
+        count = min(16, s - first)
+        t = first + fx.min(tid // QC, count - 1)
+        mine = tid // QC < count
+        cc = (tid % QC) * 4
+        if const_expr(stream):
+            sources = [
+                ld_bf4(
+                    a["blocks"], t * a["blk_sm"] + src * a["blk_sr"] + task * COLS + cc
+                )
+                for src in range(ns - 1)
+            ] + [ld_bf4(a["prefix"], t * HIDDEN + task * COLS + cc, CM_DEV)]
+        mixed = []
+        for j in range_constexpr(4):
+            acc = fx.Float32(0.0)
+            for src in range_constexpr(ns):
+                if const_expr(stream):
+                    value = sources[src][j]
+                else:
+                    value = fx.ptr_load(c["vals"] + (t * ns + src) * COLS + cc + j)
+                acc = acc + fx.ptr_load(red + t * (ns + 1) + src) * value
+            mixed.append(acc / fx.ptr_load(red + t * (ns + 1) + ns))
+        if mine:
+            for j in range_constexpr(4):
+                fx.ptr_store(mixed[j], c["vals"] + t * mixed_stride + cc + j)
+        sq = sum(value * value for value in mixed)
+        sq = butterfly(sq, (16, 8, 4, 2, 1))
+        if mine & (lane % 32 == 0):
+            c["put"](c["msq"], task * s + t, sq)
+        gpu.barrier()
+        if tid < 8 * count:
+            group, token = tid // count, first + tid % count
+            values = c["poll"](
+                [(c["msq"], (group * GSL + k) * s + token, 1) for k in range(GSL)]
+            )
+            fx.ptr_store(sum_polled(values), norm + tid)
+        gpu.barrier()
+        total = fx.ptr_load(norm + t - first)
+        for group in range_constexpr(1, 8):
+            total = total + fx.ptr_load(norm + group * count + t - first)
+        r = hw_rsq(total * fx.Float32(1.0 / HIDDEN) + fx.Float32(c["out_eps"]))
+        weight = ld_bf4(a["in_nw"], task * COLS + cc)
+        values = [
+            fx.ptr_load(c["vals"] + t * mixed_stride + cc + j) * r * weight[j]
+            for j in range(4)
+        ]
+        if mine:
+            at = (t * HIDDEN + task * COLS + cc) // 2
+            bo.buffer_store(
+                bf4_words(values), rsrc(c["xbuf"]), at, cache_modifier=CM_DEV
+            )
+            if const_expr(c["debug"]):
+                bo.buffer_store(bf4_words(values), rsrc(a["x_dbg"]), at)
+        publish(c["put"], c["xpanels"], first // 16 * NA + task, fx.Int32(1), tid == 0)
+        gpu.barrier()
+    publish(c["put"], c["xrdy"], task, fx.Int32(1), tid == 0)
+    gpu.barrier()
+

+        r = hw_rsq(total * fx.Float32(1.0 / HIDDEN) + fx.Float32(c["out_eps"]))
+        weight = ld_bf4(a["in_nw"], task * COLS + cc)
+        values = [
+            fx.ptr_load(c["vals"] + t * mixed_stride + cc + j) * r * weight[j]
+            for j in range(4)

+        if first + tid // QC < s:

+@traced
+def stage_mix(c, task):
+    """Columns 128 task ..: the softmax mix of ``vals`` (4 columns a thread), its
+    sum of squares (MSQ), every slice's -> rstd, then bf16 x = mixed rstd w ->
+    the plain x rows, and the slice's XRDY flag."""
+    if const_expr(c["S"] > 16):
+        stage_mix_wide(c, task)
+        return
+    s, ns, tid, lane, red = c["S"], c["NS"], c["tid"], c["lane"], c["red"]
+    a = c["args"]
+    c0 = task * COLS
+    nw = s * (ns + 1)
+    if const_expr(c.get("gate_local", False)):
+        stage_gate_local(c)
+    else:
+        if tid < nw:
+            v = c["poll"]([(c["wgt"], tid, 1)])[0][0]
+            fx.ptr_store(f32_of(v), red + tid)
+        gpu.barrier()
+    mine = tid < s * QC
+    t = fx.min(tid // QC, s - 1)
+    cc = (tid % QC) * 4
+    mixed = []
+    for j in range_constexpr(4):
+        acc = fx.Float32(0.0)
+        for src in range_constexpr(ns):
+            acc = acc + fx.ptr_load(red + (t * (ns + 1) + src)) * fx.ptr_load(
+                c["vals"] + ((t * ns + src) * COLS + cc + j)
+            )
+        mixed.append(acc / fx.ptr_load(red + (t * (ns + 1) + ns)))
+    sq = (
+        mixed[0] * mixed[0]
+        + mixed[1] * mixed[1]
+        + mixed[2] * mixed[2]
+        + mixed[3] * mixed[3]
+    )
+    sq = butterfly(sq, (16, 8, 4, 2, 1))
+    if mine & (lane % 32 == 0):
+        c["put"](c["msq"], task * s + t, sq)
+    gpu.barrier()
+    if tid < 8 * s:
+        g = tid // s
+        tt = tid % s
+        vals = c["poll"]([(c["msq"], (g * GSL + k) * s + tt, 1) for k in range(GSL)])
+        fx.ptr_store(sum_polled(vals), red + (128 + g * s + tt))
+    gpu.barrier()
+    tot = fx.ptr_load(red + (128 + t))
+    for g in range_constexpr(1, 8):
+        tot = tot + fx.ptr_load(red + (128 + g * s + t))
+    r = hw_rsq(tot * fx.Float32(1.0 / HIDDEN) + fx.Float32(c["out_eps"]))
+    wn = ld_bf4(a["in_nw"], c0 + cc)
+    xw = bf4_words([mixed[j] * r * wn[j] for j in range(4)])
+    if mine:
+        at = (t * HIDDEN + c0 + cc) // 2
+        bo.buffer_store(xw, rsrc(c["xbuf"]), at, cache_modifier=CM_DEV)
+        if const_expr(c["debug"]):
+            bo.buffer_store(xw, rsrc(a["x_dbg"]), at)
+    publish(c["put"], c["xrdy"], task, fx.Int32(1), tid == 0)
+    gpu.barrier()

+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- gemv CTAs
+def gemv_loads(c, rg, chunks, columns=4, first_column=0):
+    """This wave's weight operands of rows 16 rg .. for its K chunks ``chunks``
+    (indices into wave, wave + 8, ..): a lane 64 contiguous bytes of its row a
+    chunk (4 dwordx4). ``rg`` past the last group loads the last group."""
+    lane, wave = c["lane"], c["wave"]
+    r_w = rsrc(c["args"]["w_in"])
+    row = fx.min(rg, GEMV_TASKS - 1) * ROWS + lane % ROWS
+    g = lane // ROWS
+    out = []
+    for i in chunks:
+        if c.get("pipeline", 0) & 33554432:
+            group = fx.min(rg, GEMV_TASKS - 1)
+            base = (((group * PER_WAVE + i) * WAVES + wave) * 4 * 64 + lane) * 4
+            stride = 64 * 4
+        else:
+            k = (wave + WAVES * i) * KCH + g * 8
+            base = (row * HIDDEN + k) // 2  # dwords
+            stride = 16
+        out.append(
+            [
+                fx.Vector(
+                    bo.buffer_load(
+                        r_w,
+                        base + stride * q,
+                        vec_width=4,
+                        dtype=T.i32,
+                        cache_modifier=CM_NT,
+                    )
+                )
+                for q in range(first_column, columns)
+            ]
+        )
+    return out

+                    (tt * HIDDEN + half * 4096 + kk) // 2,
+                    vec_width=4,
+                    dtype=T.i32,
+                    cache_modifier=CM_DEV,
+                )
+            )
+            if tid + THREADS * i < words:
+                fx.ptr_store(v, c["xl"] + (tt * row + kk) // 2)
+    gpu.barrier()
+    t, g = fx.min(lane % ROWS, s - 1), lane // ROWS
+    for i in range_constexpr(count):
+        k = (wave + WAVES * i) * KCH + g * 8
+        for q in range_constexpr(4):
+            xb = fx.Vector(
+                fx.ptr_load(
+                    c["xl"] + (t * row + k + 32 * q) // 2,
+                    result_type=fx.Vector.make_type(4, fx.Int32),
+                )
+            ).bitcast(fx.BFloat16)
+            acc0 = mfma_bf16(ops0[i][q].bitcast(fx.BFloat16), xb, acc0)
+            acc1 = mfma_bf16(ops1[i][q].bitcast(fx.BFloat16), xb, acc1)
+    gpu.barrier()
+    return acc0, acc1
+
+
+@traced
+def projection_out(c, rg, acc):
+    """Publish a projection group's bf16 results after the K reduction."""
+    s, tid, lane, wave = c["S"], c["tid"], c["lane"], c["wave"]
+    fx.ptr_store(acc, c["red"] + (wave * 64 + lane) * 4)
+    gpu.barrier()
+    if (tid < ROWS * s) & (rg < GEMV_TASKS):
+        r, tt = tid % ROWS, tid // ROWS
+        v = bf16r(row_sum(c["red"], r, tt))
+        c["put"](c["proj"], tt * NPROJ + rg * ROWS + r, v)
+        if const_expr(c["debug"]):
+            bo.buffer_store(
+                v.to(fx.BFloat16),
+                rsrc(c["args"]["proj_dbg"]),
+                tt * NPROJ + rg * ROWS + r,
+            )
+    gpu.barrier()
+

+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- kda
+def kda_stage(c, req, h, ch):
+    """The task's inputs that need no hand-off, issued before its first poll:
+    metadata, the owned channels' conv window / weights, the initial state rows,
+    the f_b rows of this wave and the per-head constants."""
+    L, sl, tid, lane, wave = c["L"], c["SL"], c["tid"], c["lane"], c["wave"]
+    a = c["args"]
+    k = {}
+    # every value a buffer resource is built on wave-uniform (else a waterfall)
+    k["acc_idx"] = uniform(ld_i32(a["num_acc"], req)) - 1
+    k["slot_c"] = uniform(ld_i32(a["st_idx"], req * a["st_stride"]))
+    k["slot0"] = uniform(ld_i32(a["st_idx"], req * a["st_stride"] + k["acc_idx"]))
+    k["slots"] = [
+        uniform(ld_i32(a["st_idx"], req * a["st_stride"] + j)) for j in range(L)
+    ]
+    # The first 3 * VCH threads own the q, k and v conv channels.
+    ct = fx.min(tid, 3 * c["VCH"] - 1)
+    part = ct // c["VCH"]
+    chan = part * PROJ + h * HD + ch * c["VCH"] + ct % c["VCH"]
+    cs = a["conv_st"] + fx.Int64(fx.max(k["slot_c"], 0)) * fx.Int64(a["cs_seq"]) * 2
+    co = chan * a["cs_dim"]  # the channel's first entry (bf16 elements)
+    k["cs"], k["co"], k["chan"], k["part"] = cs, co, chan, part
+    k["cw"] = fx.Vector(
+        bo.buffer_load(rsrc(a["conv_w"]), chan * CONV_W, vec_width=4, dtype=T.f32)
+    )
+    k["win"] = [
+        ld_bf(cs, co + (k["acc_idx"] + j) * a["cs_tok"]) for j in range(CONV_W - 1)
+    ]
+    k["old"] = [
+        ld_bf(cs, co + (k["acc_idx"] + 1 + j) * a["cs_tok"]) for j in range(sl - L)
+    ]
+    # recurrence: thread -> state row v = tid / 32, k columns (tid % 32) 4 ..
+    vr = ch * c["VCH"] + tid // 32
+    k0 = (tid % 32) * 4
+    k["head_off"] = (h * HD + vr) * HD + k0
+    base0 = a["rstate"] + fx.Int64(fx.max(k["slot0"], 0)) * fx.Int64(a["rs_seq"]) * 4
+    if const_expr(c.get("pipeline", 0) & 2048):
+        k["st"] = c["state_preload"]
+    else:
+        k["st"] = [
+            fx.Vector(
+                bo.buffer_load(
+                    rsrc(base0), k["head_off"] + r * 16 * HD, vec_width=4, dtype=T.f32
+                )
+            )
+            for r in range(c["VCH"] // 16)
+        ]
+    # f_b: wave w's rows 16 w .. of head h, a lane 64 B of its row
+    fr = h * HD + wave * 16 + lane % 16
+    fb = (fr * HD + (lane // 16) * 32) // 2
+    k["fb"] = [
+        fx.Vector(bo.buffer_load(rsrc(a["w_fb"]), fb + 4 * q, vec_width=4, dtype=T.i32))
+        for q in range(4)
+    ]
+    k["aa"] = hw_exp2(ld_f32(a["a_log"], h) * fx.Float32(LOG2E))
+    k["dtb"] = [
+        ld_f32(a["dt_bias"], h * HD + wave * 16 + 4 * (lane // 16) + i)
+        for i in range(4)
+    ]
+    if const_expr(c.get("pipeline", 0) & 256):
+        fr_hi = h * HD + (wave % 4 + 4) * 16 + lane % 16
+        fb_hi = (fr_hi * HD + (lane // 16) * 32) // 2
+        k["fb_hi"] = [
+            fx.Vector(
+                bo.buffer_load(rsrc(a["w_fb"]), fb_hi + 4 * q, vec_width=4, dtype=T.i32)
+            )
+            for q in range(4)
+        ]
+        k["dtb_hi"] = [
+            ld_f32(a["dt_bias"], h * HD + (wave % 4 + 4) * 16 + 4 * (lane // 16) + i)
+            for i in range(4)
+        ]
+    return k
+
+
+@traced
+def kda_conv(c, k, req, h, ch):
+    """Owned channels: the spec conv update of request ``req``'s L tokens -> new
+    conv state; q / k out through QK, v to LDS."""
+    L, sl, tid = c["L"], c["SL"], c["tid"]
+    a = c["args"]
+    stamp(c["on"], c["tls"], tid, 12)
+    if tid < 3 * c["VCH"]:
+        xs = c["poll"](
+            [(c["proj"], (req * L + j) * NPROJ + k["chan"], 1) for j in range(L)]
+        )
+        xv = [f32_of(xs[j][0]) for j in range(L)]
+        stamp(c["on"], c["tls"], tid, 13)
+        rs = rsrc(k["cs"])
+        if const_expr(c["xp"] == 2):
+            # force the staged conv window before timing the stores
+            fx.ptr_store(k["old"][0] + k["win"][0], c["red"] + tid)
+            stamp(c["on"], c["tls"], tid, 13)
+        if (k["slot_c"] > 0) & (c["xp"] != 1):
+            for j in range_constexpr(sl):
+                nv = k["old"][j] if j < sl - L else xv[j - (sl - L)]
+                bo.buffer_store(
+                    fx.Float32(nv).to(fx.BFloat16), rs, k["co"] + j * a["cs_tok"]
+                )
+        stamp(c["on"], c["tls"], tid, 14)
+        seq = k["win"] + xv
+        for j in range_constexpr(L):
+            acc = fx.Float32(0.0)
+            for q in range_constexpr(CONV_W):
+                acc = acc + k["cw"][q] * seq[j + q]
+            o = bf16r(acc * sigmoid(acc))
+            if k["part"] < 2:
+                c["put"](
+                    c["qk"],
+                    ((req * NH + h) * L + j) * 2 * HD
+                    + k["part"] * HD
+                    + ch * c["VCH"]
+                    + tid % c["VCH"],
+                    o,
+                )
+            if k["part"] == 2:
+                fx.ptr_store(o, c["vloc"] + (j * c["VCH"] + tid % c["VCH"]))
+    gpu.barrier()
+
+
+@traced
+def kda_gates(c, k, req, h):
+    """f_a, beta and the head's q / k (one poll batch a thread); g1 = f_b f_a by
+    MFMA (a wave 16 rows) -> lower-bound gate -> decay in LDS; q / k l2-normed
+    (q scaled)."""
+    L, tid, lane, wave = c["L"], c["tid"], c["lane"], c["wave"]
+    n_fa = L * HD
+    n = n_fa + L * 2 * HD
+    per = (n + THREADS - 1) // THREADS
+    specs = []
+    for i in range_constexpr(per):
+        e = fx.min(tid + THREADS * i, n - 1)
+        fa_at = (req * L + e // HD) * NPROJ + FA_0 + e % HD
+        qk_at = (req * NH + h) * L * 2 * HD + (e - n_fa)
+        specs.append((e, fa_at, qk_at))
+    # two regions, two batches: the f_a pairs, then the q / k pairs
+    got_fa = c["poll"](
+        [(c["proj"], fx.min(fa, (req * L + L) * NPROJ - 1), 1) for _, fa, _ in specs]
+    )
+    got_qk = c["poll"](
+        [(c["qk"], fx.max(qk, (req * NH + h) * L * 2 * HD), 1) for _, _, qk in specs]
+    )
+    for i in range_constexpr(per):
+        e = specs[i][0]
+        if tid + THREADS * i < n_fa:
+            fx.ptr_store(f32_of(got_fa[i][0]), c["fa"] + e)
+        if (tid + THREADS * i >= n_fa) & (tid + THREADS * i < n):
+            fx.ptr_store(f32_of(got_qk[i][0]), c["qkl"] + (e - n_fa))
+    if tid < L:
+        b = c["poll"]([(c["proj"], (req * L + tid) * NPROJ + BETA_0 + h, 1)])[0][0]
+        fx.ptr_store(sigmoid(f32_of(b)), c["beta"] + tid)
+    gpu.barrier()
+    # g1 rows 16 wave .. x tokens: A = f_b rows (staged), B = f_a [token][K]
+    t = fx.min(lane % 16, L - 1)
+    acc = fx.Vector.filled(4, 0.0, fx.Float32)
+    for q in range_constexpr(4):
+        kb = (lane // 16) * 32 + 8 * q
+        xs = [fx.ptr_load(c["fa"] + (t * HD + kb + e)) for e in range(8)]
+        xb = fx.Vector.from_elements(xs, fx.Float32).to(fx.BFloat16)
+        acc = mfma_bf16(k["fb"][q].bitcast(fx.BFloat16), xb, acc)
+    for i in range_constexpr(4):
+        kk = wave * 16 + 4 * (lane // 16) + i
+        g = bf16r(acc[i]) + k["dtb"][i]
+        gate = fx.Float32(c["lb"]) * sigmoid(k["aa"] * g)
+        if lane % 16 < L:
+            fx.ptr_store(hw_exp2(gate * fx.Float32(LOG2E)), c["decay"] + (t * HD + kk))
+    # l2norm: q / k row r (2 L rows of 128) on wave r % 8
+    for rr in range_constexpr((2 * L + WAVES - 1) // WAVES):
+        row = fx.min(wave + WAVES * rr, 2 * L - 1)
+        x0 = fx.ptr_load(c["qkl"] + (row * HD + lane))
+        x1 = fx.ptr_load(c["qkl"] + (row * HD + 64 + lane))
+        ss = butterfly(x0 * x0 + x1 * x1, (32, 16, 8, 4, 2, 1))
+        sc = hw_rsq(ss + fx.Float32(1e-6))
+        sc = (row % 2 == 0).select(sc * fx.Float32(HD**-0.5), sc)
+        if wave + WAVES * rr < 2 * L:
+            fx.ptr_store(x0 * sc, c["qkl"] + (row * HD + lane))
+            fx.ptr_store(x1 * sc, c["qkl"] + (row * HD + 64 + lane))
+    gpu.barrier()
+
+
+@traced
+def kda_recur(c, k, req, h, ch):
+    """State rows VCH ch .. of head h: the recurrence over the L tokens, a state
+    written a token, bf16 outputs to LDS ``ol`` and their partial norms (ONRM)."""
+    L, tid, lane = c["L"], c["tid"], c["lane"]
+    a = c["args"]
+    v = tid // 32
+    k0 = (tid % 32) * 4
+    live0 = k["slot0"] > 0
+    stv = [
+        [live0.select(k["st"][r][e], fx.Float32(0.0)) for e in range(4)]
+        for r in range(c["VCH"] // 16)
+    ]
+    for j in range_constexpr(L):
+        qv = [fx.ptr_load(c["qkl"] + ((2 * j) * HD + k0 + e)) for e in range(4)]
+        kv = [fx.ptr_load(c["qkl"] + ((2 * j + 1) * HD + k0 + e)) for e in range(4)]
+        dk = [fx.ptr_load(c["decay"] + (j * HD + k0 + e)) for e in range(4)]
+        beta = fx.ptr_load(c["beta"] + j)
+        slot = k["slots"][j]
+        for r in range_constexpr(c["VCH"] // 16):
+            stv[r] = [stv[r][e] * dk[e] for e in range(4)]
+            p = (
+                stv[r][0] * kv[0]
+                + stv[r][1] * kv[1]
+                + stv[r][2] * kv[2]
+                + stv[r][3] * kv[3]
+            )
+            p = butterfly(p, (16, 8, 4, 2, 1))
+            vn = (fx.ptr_load(c["vloc"] + (j * c["VCH"] + v + 16 * r)) - p) * beta
+            stv[r] = [stv[r][e] + vn * kv[e] for e in range(4)]
+            o = (
+                stv[r][0] * qv[0]
+                + stv[r][1] * qv[1]
+                + stv[r][2] * qv[2]
+                + stv[r][3] * qv[3]
+            )
+            o = live0.select(bf16r(butterfly(o, (16, 8, 4, 2, 1))), fx.Float32(0.0))
+            if (slot > 0) & live0:
+                dst = rsrc(a["rstate"] + fx.Int64(slot) * fx.Int64(a["rs_seq"]) * 4)
+                bo.buffer_store(
+                    fx.Vector.from_elements(stv[r], fx.Float32),
+                    dst,
+                    k["head_off"] + r * 16 * HD,
+                )
+            if lane % 32 == 0:
+                fx.ptr_store(o, c["ol"] + (j * c["VCH"] + v + 16 * r))
+    gpu.barrier()
+    if const_expr(c.get("pipeline", 0) & 512):
+        for first in range_constexpr(0, L, WAVES):
+            token = c["wave"] + first
+            if token < L:
+                x = fx.ptr_load(c["ol"] + (token * c["VCH"] + lane % c["VCH"]))
+                ss = (lane < c["VCH"]).select(x * x, fx.Float32(0.0))
+                ss = butterfly(ss, (32, 16, 8, 4, 2, 1))
+                if lane == 0:
+                    c["put"](
+                        c["onrm"], ((req * NH + h) * L + token) * c["NVCH"] + ch, ss
+                    )
+    else:
+        if tid < L:
+            ss = fx.Float32(0.0)
+            for e in range_constexpr(c["VCH"]):
+                x = fx.ptr_load(c["ol"] + (tid * c["VCH"] + e))
+                ss = ss + x * x
+            c["put"](c["onrm"], ((req * NH + h) * L + tid) * c["NVCH"] + ch, ss)
+    gpu.barrier()
+
+
+@traced
+def kda_norm(c, req, h, ch):
+    """Rows VCH ch ..: gated RMSNorm over the head's 128 (every chunk's partial)
+    -> core_out."""
+    L, tid = c["L"], c["tid"]
+    a = c["args"]
+    tagged_core = c.get("core_mailbox") is not None
+    if tid < L * c["VCH"]:
+        j = tid // c["VCH"]
+        e = tid % c["VCH"]
+        vr = ch * c["VCH"] + e
+        got = c["poll"](
+            [
+                (c["onrm"], ((req * NH + h) * L + j) * c["NVCH"] + q, 1)
+                for q in range(c["NVCH"])
+            ]
+            + [(c["proj"], (req * L + j) * NPROJ + G2_0 + h * HD + vr, 1)]
+        )
+        ss = sum_polled(got[: c["NVCH"]])
+        r = hw_rsq(ss * fx.Float32(1.0 / HD) + fx.Float32(c["onorm_eps"]))
+        y = (
+            fx.ptr_load(c["ol"] + (j * c["VCH"] + e))
+            * r
+            * ld_bf(a["on_w"], vr)
+            * sigmoid(f32_of(got[c["NVCH"]][0]))
+        )
+        bo.buffer_store(
+            y.to(fx.BFloat16), rsrc(a["core_out"]), (req * L + j) * PROJ + h * HD + vr
+        )
+        if const_expr(tagged_core):
+            neighbor = xshfl(y, 1)
+            if tid % 2 == 0:
+                c["put_bf"](
+                    c["core_mailbox"],
+                    (req * L + j) * PROJ + h * HD + vr,
+                    [y, neighbor],
+                )
+    gpu.barrier()
+
+
+@traced
+def kda_task(c, task, on, tls):
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.mono.attention import parallel
+
+    tid = c["tid"]
+    req = task // (NH * c["NVCH"])
+    h = (task // c["NVCH"]) % NH
+    ch = task % c["NVCH"]
+    if const_expr("event_prod_base" in c):
+        parallel.event(c, c["event_prod_base"] + task, 0)
+    k = kda_stage(c, req, h, ch)
+    stamp(on, tls, tid, 7)
+    kda_conv(c, k, req, h, ch)
+    stamp(on, tls, tid, 8)
+    if const_expr("event_prod_base" in c):
+        parallel.event(c, c["event_prod_base"] + task, 1)
+    if const_expr(c.get("pipeline", 0) & 256):
+        parallel.wave_gates(c, k, req, h)
+    elif const_expr(c.get("pipeline", 0) & 12):
+        parallel.head_load(c, req, h)
+    elif const_expr(c.get("pipeline", 0) & 1):
+        parallel.gates(c, k, req, h)
+    else:
+        kda_gates(c, k, req, h)
+    stamp(on, tls, tid, 9)
+    if const_expr("event_prod_base" in c):
+        parallel.event(c, c["event_prod_base"] + task, 2)
+    if const_expr(c.get("pipeline", 0) & 4):
+        parallel.recur(c, k, req, h, ch, task)
+    else:
+        kda_recur(c, k, req, h, ch)
+        stamp(on, tls, tid, 10)
+        if const_expr("event_prod_base" in c):
+            parallel.event(c, c["event_prod_base"] + task, 3)
+        kda_norm(c, req, h, ch)
+        if const_expr("event_prod_base" in c):
+            parallel.event(c, c["event_prod_base"] + task, 4)
+    stamp(on, tls, tid, 11)
+
+
+@traced
+def kda_tasks(c, on, tls):
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.mono.attention import parallel
+
+    s, L, bid = c["S"], c["L"], c["bid"]
+    if const_expr(c.get("pipeline", 0) & TOKEN_PIPELINE):
+        count = c["head_workers"]
+        producers = BLOCKS - count
+        if bid < producers:
+            for task in range(bid, (s // L) * NH * c["NVCH"], producers):
+                kda_task(c, task, on, tls)
+        else:
+            for head in range(bid - producers, s // L * NH, count):
+                parallel.head_prepare(c, head)
+                for token in range_constexpr(L):
+                    parallel.output(c, head * L + token)
+    elif const_expr(c.get("pipeline", 0) & 8):
+        heads = c["head_total"]
+        producers = BLOCKS - heads
+        if bid < heads:
+            first = c["head_first"]
+            if (bid >= first) & (bid < first + s // L * NH):
+                parallel.head_prepare(c, bid - first)
+        else:
+            task0 = (
+                bid - heads - c["event_prod_base"] % producers + producers
+            ) % producers
+            for task in range(task0, s // L * NH * c["NVCH"], producers):
+                kda_task(c, task, on, tls)
+    elif const_expr(c.get("pipeline", 0) & 4):
+        count = c["head_workers"]
+        producers = BLOCKS - count
+        if bid < producers:
+            for task in range(bid, (s // L) * NH * c["NVCH"], producers):
+                kda_task(c, task, on, tls)
+        else:
+            for task in range(bid - producers, s // L * NH, count):
+                parallel.head_prepare(c, task)
+            for task in range(bid - producers, s * NH, count):
+                parallel.output(c, task)
+    else:
+        for task in range(
+            first_task(bid, c["kda0"]), (s // L) * NH * c["NVCH"], BLOCKS
+        ):
+            kda_task(c, task, on, tls)

+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- kernel
+_BUILDS: dict = {}
+

+def build(key: KdaPreBuild):
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.mono.attention import parallel
+
+    if key in _BUILDS:
+        return _BUILDS[key]
+    state_rows = _state_rows(key)
+    assert state_rows in (16, 32)
+    nvch = HD // state_rows
+    tile_tokens = 16
+    tiles = token_tiles(key.tokens, key.qlen, tile_tokens=tile_tokens)
+    s, L = max(rows for _, rows in tiles), key.qlen
+    base_pipeline = key.pipeline
+    if key.pipeline & MAILBOX_OUTPUT:
+        assert key.pipeline & TOKEN_PIPELINE
+    if key.pipeline & TOKEN_PIPELINE:
+        assert key.pipeline & 4
+        assert s // L * NH <= key.head_workers
+        base_pipeline = key.pipeline & ~(TOKEN_PIPELINE | MAILBOX_OUTPUT | 4)
+    assert base_pipeline in (
+        *range(9),
+        16,
+        32,
+        64,
+        96,
+        128,
+        256,
+        512,
+        520,
+        768,
+        1024,
+        1536,
+        2048,
+        2560,
+        4096,
+        8192,
+        16384,
+        2113536,
+        33562624,
+        33570816,
+        35667968,
+    )
+    assert key.projection_chunks in (1, 2, 3, 4)
+    assert 1 <= key.head_workers <= 32
+    if key.pipeline & 4:
+        assert s // L * NH * nvch <= BLOCKS - key.head_workers
+    if key.pipeline & 8:
+        assert s // L * NH * nvch <= BLOCKS - key.tokens // L * NH
+    if key.pipeline & 2048:
+        assert s // L * NH * nvch <= BLOCKS
+    ns = key.nblocks + 1
+    layouts = [
+        scratch_layout(replace(key, tokens=rows, state_rows=state_rows))
+        for _, rows in tiles
+    ]
+    offsets = []
+    total = 0
+    for layout in layouts:
+        total = (total + 255) // 256 * 256
+        offsets.append(total)
+        total += max(o + n for o, n in layout.values())
+    xcols = 4096 if s > TILE_TOKENS else HIDDEN
+    if key.pipeline & 2:
+        xcols = WAVES * KCH
+    if key.pipeline & 64:
+        xcols = key.projection_chunks * WAVES * KCH
+    if key.pipeline & 128:
+        xcols = 0
+    if key.pipeline & 4096:
+        xcols = 14 * KCH
+    if key.pipeline & 24576:
